headline: Thomas could return this weekend
body: Coventry Telegraph (Andy Turner), 29 Oct 2026 15:38: Lampard confirmed Thomas is a doubt for Sunderland with a 'small' calf injury — 'thankfully not as was feared' around the Achilles. 'So we're not sure about this weekend. We'll see. We've got another 48 hours… the injury is hopefully not a terrible one.' Mfuni on standby; Latibeaudiere only other option with Amenda out to Christmas.
